views.name: unique_products_per_segment_year
views.body_sql: SELECT h.segment, f.fiscal_year AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT f.product_code) AS unique_product_count FROM hardware_fact_sales_monthly f JOIN hardware_dim_product h ON f.product_code = h.product_code GROUP BY h.segment, f.fiscal_year
views.description: distinct product counts grouped by segment and year

views.name: segment_growth_metrics
views.body_sql: SELECT p20.segment, p20.unique_product_count AS unique_product_count_2020, CASE WHEN p20.unique_product_count = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((p21.unique_product_count - p20.unique_product_count) * 100.0 / p20.unique_product_count) END AS percentage_increase_2020_to_2021 FROM unique_products_per_segment_year p20 LEFT JOIN unique_products_per_segment_year p21 ON p20.segment = p21.segment AND p20.year = 2020 AND p21.year = 2021 WHERE p20.year = 2020
views.description: join 2020 and 2021 counts per segment to compute percentage increase
